jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren Solution Architect met een sterk track record in data & AI, en beweeg je je moeiteloos op het snijvlak van business, technologie en het commerciële luik? Heb je een consulting mindset en vertaal je dankzij je expertise in dataplatformen en AI complexe klantvragen naar slimme, toekomstgerichte oplossingen? Als Presales Data & AI Solution Architect binnen ons Data & AI team bij Cegeka speel je een sleutelrol in het binnenhalen van nieuwe data- en AI-trajecten, je begeleidt het volledige presalestraject van eerste gesprek tot deal.

Je bent een drijvende kracht in presales trajecten en complexe offertedossiers: je leidt en ondersteunt presales trajecten, RFP’s en tenders rond data- en AI-oplossingen
Je vertaalt klantvragen naar sterke, onderscheidende oplossingen en overtuigende voorstellen
Je bouwt end-to-end architecturen rond dataplatformen (Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Data Governance) en AI use cases (GenAI, Agentic AI, LLM’s, ML, Computer Vision, …)
Je werkt business cases uit met zowel technische diepgang als commerciële relevantie
Je presenteert en verdedigt voorstellen bij stakeholders tot op C-level
Je combineert inhoudelijke expertise met marktkennis: je detecteert opportuniteiten en creëert proactief nieuwe business
Je ondersteunt klanten in het definiëren van hun data- en AI-strategie en roadmap
Je brengt structuur in complexe omgevingen en je vertaalt dit naar toekomstbestendige architecturen

Wat breng jij mee?

Je hebt uitgebreide ervaring in data-omgevingen, bij voorkeur binnen een consultancycontext
Je beschikt over diepgaande kennis van moderne dataplatformen en ecosystemen zoals Microsoft Azure Data & AI stack (Fabric, Synapse, Data Factory, Azure Databricks, …), Snowflake en andere cloud data platformen, Data Governance, Data mesh, Data lakes en warehouses
Je hebt sterke expertise in AI-domeinen zoals GenAI, LLM’s, ML en advanced analytics
Je bent vertrouwd met het presales proces: van discovery en solutioning tot proposal en closing
Je combineert technische diepgang met commerciële flair en storytellingvaardigheden
Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en het opbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties
Je hebt een goed zicht op de markt, inclusief partners en concurrenten
Je hebt sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel in het Nederlands als Engels
Er wordt een bepaalde flexibiliteit verwacht qua verplaatsingen aangezien je regelmatig on site bij de klant werkt. Als je aanwezigheid bij de klant niet vereist is dan kan je in het Cegeka-kantoor dichtst bij je woonplaats werken (Hasselt, Gent, Antwerpen of Leuven) in combinatie met thuiswerk.

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

Je komt terecht bij een echte Top Employer
Cegeka bewijst jaar na jaar in het Whitelane Research dat we een betrouwbare en toonaangevende partner zijn op vlak van IT-dienstverlening, met een eerste plaats in 2026 voor Security Services (vierde jaar op rij), een gedeelde tweede plaats voor Cloud & Infrastructure Services en Network & Connectivity
We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat alle medewerkers hun potentieel kunnen realiseren
Wij hanteren een framework met het oog op eerlijke verloning, waarbij medewerkers worden verloond op basis van hun functie, ervaring en prestaties, onafhankelijk van gender of andere niet-werkgerelateerde kenmerken. Een elektrische wagen met laadpas of een mobiliteitsbudget, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een interessante groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, een gsm-abonnement, een forfaitaire onkostenvergoeding, een krachtige laptop en de mogelijkheid om je salarispakket een eigen accent te geven dankzij ons Flex Reward Plan
Flexibele werkuren én een mooie work/life balans
Een top team: waarin nieuwe frisse ideeën en initiatieven steeds welkom zijn! Team-events, happy hours en een steeds legendarisch bedrijfsfeest horen daar ook bij
Continu bijleren: knowledge sharing meetings, deelname aan conferenties en externe opleidingen. Kennisdeling en bijleren staan centraal! Afhankelijk van je eigen interesses en initiatieven, biedt Cegeka verschillende horizontale en verticale carrièrepaden
We hechten waarde aan duurzaamheid door CO2-neutraliteit na te streven met de elektrificatie van ons wagenpark en een milieuvriendelijk datacenter. We ontwikkelen innovatieve oplossingen met een positieve impact op milieu, mens en maatschappij, en streven naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen gewaardeerd en gehoord wordt.

Marktconform salaris met aantrekkelijke extralegale voordelen.

Continuous learning via hackathons, leesgroepen, events,...

Flexibele werktijden voor een betere balans tussen werk en privé.

Carrièregroei met horizontale en verticale ontwikkelpaden.

Hybride werkmodel dat efficiënt kantoor- en thuiswerk combineert.

Persoonlijke begeleiding door managers, coaches en sparringpartners.

ESG: lagere emissies, bevorderen van inclusie en duurzaamheid in IT.

Cegeka draagt met trots het Top Employer-certificaat.

Teamevenementen, happy hours, sport en grandioos bedrijfsfeest.

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let’s create a world we want to live in.

Job Description

We help our clients turn data into measurable value. From data platforms and analytics to AI-powered applications, we develop smart solutions for complex projects across industry, real estate, and infrastructure.

As a Solution Engineer
, you play a key role at the interface between our clients, solution architects, and product developers. You translate business needs into viable data and AI solutions, guide their implementation, and make sure they deliver real value in client projects.

Your Responsibilities

Act as the trusted point of contact for clients on Smart, Data & AI topics, from first needs assessment through to solution rollout.
Analyze business processes and translate client requirements into functional and technical requirements, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Work with solution architects to design data architectures, data models, analytics solutions, and AI use cases that fit the client's context.
Support the implementation of data, analytics, and AI solutions together with developers, architects, and data engineers.
Assess requirements against existing standard solutions, configuration options, and the need for new development.
Plan and facilitate workshops, demos, user acceptance tests, and solution validations with clients and project teams.
Support clients with adoption, training, and change management activities and feed project learnings back into solution development.
Communicate complex technical and analytical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of Smart, Data & AI offerings, methodologies, and best practices.
Take ownership beyond advisory services by actively leading and supporting the delivery and deployment of solutions, ensuring concepts are successfully translated into operational outcomes for clients.

Qualifications

Completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a comparable qualification.
At least 5 years of professional experience in consulting, business analysis, solution engineering, or solution design within data, analytics, or AI-related projects.
Proven experience working in a client-facing role between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Strong understanding of data platforms, data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, analytics solutions, BI concepts, and the fundamentals of machine learning and generative AI.
Experience in requirements engineering, process analysis, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workshop facilitation.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Understanding of data governance, security, roles, and permission concepts.
Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, data analysis, or AI technologies is considered a strong advantage.
Strong analytical thinking, a structured approach to problem-solving, and the confidence to challenge requirements constructively.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English and German.

Additional Information

To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
We promote your professional and personal development through individually tailored student mentoring
Make valuable contacts within Drees & Sommer and expand your professional network

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Coding Specialist (Fluent in Dutch) - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Spain.

As a Coding Specialist and AI Trainer, you’ll use your software engineering expertise and Dutch fluency to help improve the capabilities of advanced AI systems.

You’ll evaluate how models reason through complex programming challenges across algorithms, architecture, development, infrastructure, and systems programming.

The role combines hands-on technical assessment with linguistic evaluation, requiring you to communicate naturally and precisely in Dutch.

You’ll challenge models with realistic software engineering scenarios, identify weaknesses, and document reproducible failures to improve future model performance.

Your feedback will help strengthen AI reasoning, coding accuracy, technical communication, and problem-solving capabilities.

The position offers flexible remote contract work for technically skilled professionals who enjoy analyzing complex problems and clearly explaining their reasoning.

Your contributions will help shape AI systems designed to support software development, education, research, and other knowledge-intensive applications.

Accountabilities

Engage with advanced AI models on software engineering tasks, technical scenarios, and coding challenges in Dutch.
Evaluate model responses for logical accuracy, technical correctness, coding quality, and adherence to software engineering best practices.
Assess AI performance across areas such as algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend and backend development, cloud infrastructure, and systems programming.
Challenge models with technical topics including asynchronous programming, RESTful API integration, memory management, object-oriented design, secure coding, and distributed systems debugging.
Verify the naturalness, fluency, and correctness of Dutch language usage in technical interactions.
Identify and document model failure modes, errors, and reproducible technical issues with sufficient detail for further analysis.
Provide clear, structured feedback and suggestions to improve model reasoning, coding performance, prompt design, and evaluation methodologies.
Explain technical reasoning clearly and demonstrate your analytical process when evaluating model-generated solutions.
Contribute domain expertise that helps improve AI systems intended to support software development, research, education, and other technical applications.

Requirements

Strong professional coding or software engineering expertise, with experience across areas such as algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend or backend development, cloud infrastructure, or systems programming.
Fluent Dutch language skills, with the ability to communicate naturally and accurately about complex technical subjects.
Strong understanding of software engineering concepts and the ability to critically evaluate technical solutions and code.
Experience with topics such as asynchronous programming, REST APIs, memory management, object-oriented programming, secure coding, or distributed systems is highly relevant.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong attention to technical detail.
Ability to clearly explain technical reasoning and document findings in a structured, reproducible manner.
Strong technical writing skills in Dutch are an advantage.
Bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline is preferred.
Real-world software development experience or open-source contributions is a plus.
Strong metacognitive communication skills, including the ability to explain not only what solution is correct but why.
Ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment and consistently deliver high-quality evaluations.
Comfortable working as an independent contractor and providing your own secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

Benefits

Pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined based on experience, expertise, and geographic location.
Flexible remote contract work.
Opportunity to contribute directly to the development and improvement of advanced AI systems.
Exposure to challenging software engineering problems across a broad range of technical domains.
Opportunity to apply both coding expertise and Dutch language skills in an AI training environment.
Flexible freelance engagement without a fixed employee schedule.
Contractor arrangement with the ability to work remotely from an eligible location.
Contractors are responsible for providing their own secure computer and high-speed internet.

jobs.title: Data & AI Architect – Life Sciences
jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for a Manager / Senior Data & AI Architect to join our Barcelona team and help us grow one of BIP Iberia’s strategic areas: the application of Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence within Life Sciences.

This is not a pure architecture role. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical depth with business understanding, client-facing skills and a pre-sales/commercial mindset. Someone who can design a robust architecture, defend it with a client, understand the business problem behind it and guide the team until the solution is successfully delivered and operational.

The role will be part of BIP's Global Data & AI team, with a strong focus on working closely with our local teams in Barcelona and across Spain, while collaborating with colleagues and specialists across Portugal, Italy and other BIP geographies.

Your mission

Act as a Data & AI reference for Life Sciences, connecting strategy, business and technology. You will be involved from early client conversations and pre-sales through architecture definition, delivery and the evolution of production solutions.

You will also help build capabilities, reusable assets, propositions and references that strengthen our position in the Life Sciences market.

What you will do

Design end-to-end Data, Analytics and AI architectures covering data platforms, lakehouse, integration, governance, advanced analytics, Machine Learning, GenAI and AI agents.

Translate Life Sciences business needs into concrete, scalable, secure and measurable technology solutions.

Act as a trusted technical advisor for CIOs, CDOs, Data & AI leaders, business stakeholders and architecture teams.

Play an active role in pre-sales: discovery, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, estimates, proposals, roadmaps, high-level architectures, demos, PoCs and executive presentations.

Work jointly with commercial leaders and Partners to identify and mature opportunities, bringing technical credibility and sector knowledge.

Provide technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams including Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers and AI specialists.

Define architecture standards and patterns across security, integration, observability, MLOps/LLMOps, governance and data quality.

Support solutions through production, ensuring operability, performance, security, cost control and long-term scalability.

Contribute to the growth of the Data & AI practice in Barcelona and to BIP’s international Life Sciences collaboration.

Mentor junior colleagues and raise the technical bar through design reviews, best practices and knowledge sharing.

Industry knowledge – Life Sciences

Relevant experience or strong knowledge of the Life Sciences sector is important. The successful candidate should understand key business processes, industry challenges and the regulatory context in which clients operate.

Experience in Pharma, Biotech, MedTech, Healthcare or related environments.

Understanding of Data & AI use cases across R&D, clinical, medical affairs, commercial, market access, supply chain, manufacturing, quality or patient/healthcare analytics.

Ability to work with sensitive data and regulated environments, with awareness of privacy, traceability, quality, governance and compliance principles.

Knowledge of scientific, clinical, commercial or healthcare data ecosystems will be highly valued.

Essential requirements

Strong experience, ideally 7+ years, across Data, Analytics, Cloud or AI, with increasing responsibility in architecture and/or technical leadership.

Proven experience or strong domain knowledge in Life Sciences, with an understanding of the sector's key business processes, data ecosystems, and regulatory context.

Proven experience designing modern data solutions: data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse, streaming, APIs and integration, batch and real-time processing, modelling and governance.

Deep knowledge of at least one major hyperscaler (Azure, AWS or Google Cloud) and the ability to operate in multi-cloud environments.

Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery or equivalent technologies.

Strong SQL skills and solid Python knowledge; practical understanding of Spark and distributed architectures.

Knowledge of AI/ML and GenAI architectures, including LLMs, RAG, agents, vector search, evaluation, guardrails, observability and industrialisation patterns.

Strong client-facing experience and the ability to communicate complex decisions to both technical and executive audiences.

Hands-on experience in technical pre-sales and in preparing and defending proposals.

Professional English at a minimum C1 level. Professional Spanish. Italian or Portuguese is a plus.

Availability to work in a hybrid model based in Barcelona and to travel occasionally depending on client/project needs.

Nice to have

Previous experience in technology or strategy consulting.

Commercial or business development experience within Data & AI.

Relevant certifications across Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake or other leading platforms.

Experience in Data Governance, Data Mesh, catalogues, MDM, data quality and data-product-oriented architectures.

Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD, DevOps and platform automation.

Knowledge of FinOps and performance/cost optimisation.

Ability to build accelerators, assets and reusable solutions.

International experience, with a track record of working with stakeholders across different geographies and multicultural environments.

Personal capabilities

Consulting mindset and client orientation: listen, structure ambiguous problems and turn them into actionable decisions.

Technical credibility: ability to go deep when required while maintaining an end-to-end perspective.

Business orientation: understanding that architecture is a means to create impact, not an end in itself.

Communication and influencing skills: confidently present and defend proposals to technical teams, business stakeholders and senior management.

Commercial and pre-sales mindset: comfortable participating in opportunity discussions and shaping a compelling value proposition.

Leadership without hierarchy: ability to mobilise teams, make decisions and build trust.

Pragmatism, autonomy and end-to-end ownership.

Curiosity and continuous learning in a fast-moving technology environment.

What we offer

A strategic role supporting the growth of Data & AI and Life Sciences within BIP Iberia.

High client ex
posure and direct participation in relevant transformation initiatives.

Real opportunity to influence the development of the practice and new business opportunities.

Collaboration with international teams and specialists across multiple geographies.

Data, Analytics, AI and GenAI projects using leading technologies.

Professional development, training and support for certifications.

Hybrid working model based in Barcelona, with flexibility aligned to project needs.

Competitive compensation aligned with experience and responsibility.

Why BIP?

Growth & Learning

Access to 300+ courses on emerging technologies and business topics, personalized development programs, and continuous training initiatives to support your professional and personal growth.

Flexibility & Work-Life Integration

Hybrid working model with flexibility to balance remote and office work in agreement with your manager and project needs, plus initiatives supporting work-life balance.

Health & Benefits

Private health insurance, wellness platforms, meal vouchers, and an attractive benefits package.

Family & Parenthood

Support for new parents, including enhanced parental leave benefits and dedicated initiatives during and after parental leave.

Inclusion & Values

We promote uniqueness and equal opportunities for everyone. We are committed to creating an ethical, inclusive, and welcoming work environment.

Next Steps

Once we receive your CV, we will carefully review your profile. If there is a match with this or other open positions within the Group, we will contact you to start our mutual introduction process.

The selection process generally includes an HR interview, a technical interview with a Line Manager, and potentially a final interview with a Partner. The number and order of interviews may vary.

About Us

Founded in 2003, BIP combines the historical excellence of management consulting with innovation and digitalization. Today we are more than 6.500 professionals across 13 countries, delivering over 4,500 projects worldwide.

We support our clients in driving large-scale impact through Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4.0, IoT, and disruptive technologies across all industries.

We believe in excellence as our guiding principle and adopt an ethical and fair approach toward everyone who chooses to work with us, fostering an environment where people grow together through diverse expertise.

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect and Product Owner – Cost Value Engineering
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As the AI Solution Architect and Product Owner – Cost Value Engineering (CVE), you are the technical anchor of a newly launched, high-impact AI initiative within our global procurement and engineering function. You design and own the localized, high-performance architecture required to execute complex, end-to-end engineering AI solutions. Operating as the definitive bridge between our specialized business needs and Central IT’s secure environment, you govern the technical backlog, steer development, and architect the integrations that power our tools. You ensure our AI solutions are scalable, secure, and directly drive business value for our engineering community and beyond.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Establish & Own Local CVE AI Platform: Build and govern the dedicated environment hosting our specialized AI applications and intelligent agents.
Architect Specialized Integration: Connect Central IT’s secure LLMs to localized engineering databases and low-code platforms, maximizing component reuse.
Govern AI Deployments: Act as the technical tollgate for all releases. Ensure solutions meet Central IT standards and validate business ROI before launch.
Guide Decentralized Teams: Mentor business-driven use case teams. Translate complex engineering problems into actionable, logical agile sprints.
Enable Citizen Developers: Architect the foundational frameworks allowing domain experts to securely build, test, and deploy their own AI solutions.
Design Product Backlog: Translate macro-business requirements into clear technical deliverables and manage the delivery pipeline.
Drive AI Roadmap: Prioritize rapid, high-impact Proof of Concepts (POCs) to secure immediate wins, basing execution on technical feasibility and accurate effort estimation.

What You Bring

Master’s degree in computer science, IT Systems Engineering, or a highly relevant technical experience.
5+ years of technical delivery experience, with a proven track record in software engineering, architecture, and driving agile AI/ML product lifecycles.
Strong Product Ownership credentials, specifically managing complex requirements pipelines, backlog refinement, and sprint executions.
Technical command of deploying modern AI frameworks (RAG, multi-agent architectures) within strict enterprise security boundaries.
Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot, responsible AI practices, governance frameworks, security, compliance, and value realization.
Experience with cloud, data, and analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or Microsoft Fabric) and with data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data integration is a plus.
Strong programming experience with Python and SQL with knowledge in API connectivity and backend services from development through deployment.
Knowledge of LLM integration techniques, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, embeddings, and fine-tuning approaches.
Supply chain and/or manufacturing knowledge is a plus.

About The Team

The Cost and Value Engineering (CVE) function is the driver of cost transparency and optimization for externally purchased material, components, and systems in the global Siemens Energy product portfolio. We are a diverse and agile team, which centrally supports all Siemens Energy business areas in achieving their goals with focus on competitiveness and profitability.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

Annual bonus
Working with international team
Flexible working hours and possibility to work from home
Meal allowance

Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong attention to technical detail.

Strong educational background with a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

Strong proficiency with at least one major cloud provider, backed by AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), Google Certified Professional Cloud Architect, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (Exam AZ-305) certifications

Strong proficiency with leading architectural decision processes and documenting system components and technical strategies in line with organizational and industry standards
Advanced experience with cross-functional leadership, guiding multi-disciplinary teams and collaborating effectively with senior stakeholders to deliver architectural vision
Strong experience with mentoring and coaching architects and technical leaders, fostering a culture of architectural excellence and continuous professional growth
Strong commitment to continuous learning and adaptation, staying ahead of technology trends, emerging tools, and architecture best practices
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain complex architectural concepts to technical and non-technical audiences
Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, thriving in cross-functional environments and building consensus across diverse stakeholder groups
Strong strategic and analytical mindset, with the ability to think holistically about systems, identify risks, and define clear architectural roadmaps
Strong leadership capabilities, demonstrating ownership, accountability, and influence without relying solely on formal authority

new_jobs.title: C# Developer
new_jobs.description:
Beschrijving van het bedrijf

Eurofins Milieu is een toonaangevende speler op het gebied van milieuonderzoek in Nederland en België. Met onze geaccrediteerde laboratoria voeren we dagelijks chemische, fysische en biologische analyses uit in uiteenlopende milieu-matrices. Dankzij jarenlange expertise zijn we niet alleen sterk in routinematige analyses, maar ook in specialistisch en niet-standaard onderzoek. Samen werken we – van monstername tot digitale rapportage – aan betrouwbare inzichten voor onder andere overheden, waterbeheerders, adviesbureaus en de industrie.

Functieomschrijving

Wij zijn op zoek naar een getalenteerde C# Developer om ons dynamische team in Barneveld te versterken. Als C# Developer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van hoogwaardige softwareapplicaties met behulp van C# en het .NET framework.

Momenteel zijn we bijvoorbeeld bezig met het ontwikkelen van een compleet nieuwe software suite en verdere automatisering van ons laboratorium.

Let op: per juni 2026 verhuist ons kantoor van Barneveld naar Amersfoort.

Wat ga je doen?

Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van robuuste en schaalbare softwareoplossingen met behulp van C# en .NET (latest versions)
Werken aan backend-gedreven applicaties, met o.a. API-koppelingen en integraties
Samenwerken met cross-functionele teams om requirements op te halen en door te vertalen naar technische oplossingen
Schrijven van schone, efficiënte en goed gedocumenteerde code volgens best practices (SOLID/design patterns)
Uitvoeren van code reviews en werken met pull requests binnen een Git-based omgeving
Werken met CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) voor deployments en releases
Waarborgen van codekwaliteit via o.a. unit tests, integration tests en tools zoals SonarQube
Troubleshooten, debuggen en optimaliseren van performance

Functie-eisen

Bachelordiploma in Informatica, Software Engineering of een verwant vakgebied
3+ jaar professionele ervaring in C# development
Ervaring met .NET (bij voorkeur de nieuwste versies)
Kennis van SQL Server en database management
Ervaring met Git, Azure DevOps en CI/CD pipelines
Ervaring met API’s en backend development (frontend is minder relevant, maar kennis van bijv. Blazor is een pré)
Ervaring met unit testing / integration testing
Sterke probleemoplossende vaardigheden en aandacht voor detail
Kennis van Agile ontwikkelingsmethodologieën
Het vermogen om efficiënt te werken in een snelle, collaboratieve omgeving

Aanvullende informatie

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een bruto maandsalaris tot €5500 o.b.v. fulltime (fulltime werkweek bedraagt 38,16 uur)
Goede secundaire voorwaarden zoals aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling, 26 vakantiedagen (ook mogelijkheid tot bijkopen) en andere voordelen
Een uitdagende werkomgeving binnen een ambitieuze, internationale en sterk groeiende organisatie
De mogelijkheid om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen de organisatie
Een team met enthousiaste en gedreven collega’s
Flexibele werkmogelijkheden: hybride werken voor een goede werk-privébalans (balans ligt ongeveer op 50% met afgesproken kantoordagen).

Kortom: een echte uitdaging voor een ambitieuze, energieke en creatieve professional die denkt in oplossingen!

Voldoe je aan bovenstaand profiel en ben je geïnteresseerd in een informele, betrokken en prettige werksfeer, dan zien we graag je CV en motivatie tegemoet!

Over Eurofins

Eurofins Scientific is een internationaal beursgenoteerd life sciences bedrijf dat haar klanten voorziet van hoogwaardig laboratoriumonderzoek en advies. Eurofins is wereldwijd marktleider op het gebied van bio-analytische testen voor levensmiddelen, water, milieu, cosmetica, farmaceutische producten en contract research voor agro science. Daarnaast is Eurofins één van de grootste aanbieders ter wereld in testing en laboratorium services in genomics, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences, medicijnontwikkeling en clinical studies. Eurofins gebruikt daarvoor haar portfolio van ruim 200.000 unieke analysemethoden en een ongekend hoog kennisniveau en expertise.

Eurofins bestaat wereldwijd uit circa 65.000 medewerkers, verdeeld over 900 hyper moderne laboratoria en is actief in 60 landen met een pro-forma omzet van 6.95€ Mio in 2024. Eurofins kent sterke groeiambities (CAGR 24%) met naast zeer sterke autonome groei middels eigen start-ups ook jaarlijks een groot aantal acquisities.

De geaccrediteerde laboratoria van Eurofins Milieu bieden in Nederland een uitgebreid pakket aan chemische, fysische en biologische analyses in alle milieu matrices. Door jarenlange ervaring heeft zij uitvoerige kennis op het gebied van zowel routinematige analyses als niet standaard analyses waaronder analyses van bijzondere verbindingen en microverontreinigingen. Eurofins is marktleider op het gebied van specialistisch onderzoek; opdrachtgevers zijn onder meer waterkwaliteitsbeheerders, Rijkswaterstaat, provinciale en gemeentelijke overheden, milieu-adviesbureaus, industrie en aannemers. Circa 600 gemotiveerde deskundigen verzorgen het traject van monstername tot aan de digitale rapportage van de analyseresultaten. Analyses vinden voornamelijk plaats in de grote laboratoria in Amsterdam (Eurofins Omegam) en Barneveld (Eurofins Analytico).

As an Software Development Engineer in Test, you operate at the intersection of software development and quality engineering. You design and build high-quality test infrastructure and automation in the same way developers build production systems. With your strong programming skills in C++and/or Python, you ensure software is testable, scalable, and reliable by design. You work closely with software engineers on complex high-tech systems, contributing directly to codebases, test architecture, and continuous integration pipelines. Rather than only validating software, you actively shape how it is built and verified.

Your responsibilities as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET):

Design, develop, and maintain test frameworks and automation tooling using C++ and/or Python
Contribute to production code and testability improvements in collaboration with software engineers

new_jobs.description:
Wat we samen gaan bereiken:

Dit ga je doen:

Als Senior Test Automation Engineer bij Astek Nederland kom je niet om simpelweg scripts te runnen. Onze klanten (van de energiesector tot de semi-overheid) zitten vaak midden in uitdagende transities: van legacy naar cloud-native, of van handmatig testen naar full-blown CI/CD pipelines. Jij bent de specialist die de klant helpt navigeren. Of de stack nu vraagt om Cypress, Playwright, Tosca of Robot Framework: jij doorgrondt de architectuur en adviseert over de beste aanpak. Jij bent degene die developers meeneemt in het verhaal dat kwaliteit een gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid is. Kortom: jij brengt de senioriteit die nodig is om testautomatisering strategisch te laten landen.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

Strategisch Advies: Je kijkt verder dan de bug. Je analyseert de behoeften van de klant en adviseert over de teststrategie en tooling die optimaal aansluit bij hun specifieke architectuur.
Engineeren: Je bouwt en optimaliseert robuuste, schaalbare frameworks die standhouden in een continu veranderende omgeving.
CI/CD Integratie: Je zorgt dat geautomatiseerde tests een integraal en betrouwbaar onderdeel worden van de deployment pipeline (bijv. Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
Lead & Coaching: In consultancy-omgevingen ben jij de deskundige. Je coacht collega's en neemt een natuurlijke voortrekkersrol binnen Agile-teams om de kwaliteitsstandaard te verhogen.

Wat jou onderscheidt:

Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in testautomatisering en bent gewend om te acteren binnen complexe enterprise-omgevingen.
Tooling is voor jou een middel, geen doel. Je hebt diepgaande kennis van (meerdere) frameworks zoals Cypress, Playwright, Tosca, Selenium of Robot Framework.
Je hebt ruime ervaring met API-testen en begrijpt hoe microservices en moderne architecturen in elkaar steken.
Je bent communicatief sterk: je kunt technische keuzes onderbouwen richting zowel developers als management.
Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Waarom Astek voor jou de juiste stap is:

Bij ons heb je de regie over je eigen loopbaan, zowel in je projecten als in je beloning. Kies je beloningsmodel: Ga je voor het Profit-model (een unieke combinatie van zekerheid en een zeer hoog variabel inkomen voor de ondernemende professional) of liever voor het Solid-model (een stabiel, hoog marktconform salaris met uitgebreide extra's)?
Onbeperkt Groeien: Wij geloven niet in vaste budgetten. Heb jij een specifieke certificering of training nodig om de beste te blijven in je vak? Wij regelen het. Zonder limiet.
Brabantse Gezelligheid: We zijn een hecht team met korte lijnen. Naast de inhoud maken we tijd voor fun: van jaarlijkse citytrips (Marbella!) tot regiouitjes en familiedagen.

Dit bieden wij

Een vast contract vanaf dag één
Een competitief salarispakket afgestemd op jouw ervaring -> wil je alvast een beeld hebben? Neem dan een kijkje naar onze salarismeter
28 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen
Hybride werken, je werkt 1 tot 2 dagen op kantoor bij de klant
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling
Flexibele mobiliteitsvergoeding voor auto, OV of fiets – of leaseauto
Een cafetariaregeling voor aankopen die jou in je werk ondersteunen, denk aan een telefoon, laptop etc. (50% belastingvoordeel)
Onbeperkt opleidingsbudget (We vergoeden alle opleidingen en trainingen die bijdragen aan jouw professionele ontwikkeling)
Samenwerking met OpenUp: toegang tot gecertificeerde psychologen, workshops en ondersteuning voor jou en je familie
Ieder kwartaal uitjes met collega's en een jaarlijkse internationale trip (Zo zijn we o.a. al geweest in Dublin, Mallorca, Ibiza, Valencia, Barcelona, Lissabon en dit jaar gaan we naar Marbella!)

new_jobs.title: Solution Engineer / Architect (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
Das sind wir:

BuildlinX entwickelt die nächste Generation der Gebäudeautomation. Damit packen wir eines der größten Klimaprobleme unserer Zeit an: Der Gebäudebetrieb verursacht rund 30 % der globalen CO₂-Emissionen. Genau hier setzen wir an - und machen Gebäude grundlegend effizienter und klimafreundlicher.

Mit einem Team von rund 20 Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir dafür die Technologie und die Werkzeuge, die Gebäudeautomation einfacher und skalierbarer machen. Gemeinsam mit einem etablierten öffentlichen Innovationspartner bringen wir die moderne Gebäudeautomation bereits heute im großen Maßstab in die Praxis und treiben so einen ganzen Markt in Richtung Zukunft.

Unsere Software und Werkzeuge verbinden digitale und physische Systeme miteinander. Genau dafür suchen wir jemanden, der komplexe Technologie versteht, Zusammenhänge erkennt und Lust darauf hat, unsere technische Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten.

Aufgaben

Das machst Du bei uns:

Technische Konzepte entwickeln: Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Produkt, Projekten und Business in tragfähige technische Lösungsansätze und entscheidest aktiv mit, wie wir diese umsetzen.

Architektur & Systeme gestalten: Du arbeitest Dich in unsere Softwarearchitektur ein, analysierst Schnittstellen, APIs sowie Datenflüsse und verbindest Software, Daten und physische Systeme zu einem funktionierenden Gesamtsystem.

KI konsequent einsetzen: Du setzt KI intensiv in der Softwareentwicklung ein und entwickelst mit uns Ansätze, um Entwicklungsarbeit weiter zu automatisieren.

Hands-on Umsetzen & Bauen: Du bringst deine Architekturen, Konzepte und KI-Ansätze selbst auf die Straße und setzt sie aktiv, eigenständig und pragmatisch in Code und Systemen um.

Echte Ownership übernehmen: Du greifst Dir Verantwortung aktiv, packst Herausforderungen selbstständig und lösungsorientiert an und treibst Themen eigeninitiativ voran.

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit:

Technischer Hintergrund: Du hast ein Studium der Ingenieurwissenschaften oder Informatik (z. B. Technische Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik) absolviert oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit relevanter Berufserfahrung mit.

Berufserfahrung: Du hast idealerweise mindestens zwei bis drei Jahre Berufserfahrung nach Deinem Studium gesammelt und bereits an echten technischen Systemen gearbeitet.

Software- & Architekturverständnis: Du hast mehr als eine Programmiersprache produktiv eingesetzt, verstehst moderne (z. B. verteilte/Microservice-) Architekturen und denkst in APIs, Schnittstellen und durchgängigen Datenflüssen.

Problemlösung: Du kannst komplexe technische Herausforderungen strukturiert analysieren und verschiedene Lösungswege gegeneinander abwägen.

KI Mindset: Du beschäftigst Dich intensiv damit, wie KI Softwareentwicklung verändert und hast bereits Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Entwicklungsprozessen.

Hands-on Mentalität: Du willst nicht nur planen und konzipieren, sondern brennst darauf, deine Ideen und Lösungen selbst hands-on zu entwickeln, zu bauen und in die Praxis umzusetzen.

Kommunikation: Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären, Entscheidungen vertreten und nachvollziehbar dokumentieren. Dein Deutsch ist mindestens auf C1-Niveau.

Kein Muss, aber ein Plus:

Event Driven Architectures und Datenplattformen

Embedded Systems oder Hardware-Integration

DevOps oder Cybersecurity

Erfahrung in den Bereichen Energie, Infrastruktur oder Gebäudeautomation

Benefits

Das sind Deine Vorteile bei uns:

Verantwortung & Team: Bei uns kannst Du technische Entscheidungen nicht nur vorbereiten, sondern wirklich mitgestalten. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit unserem CTO, unserem Entwicklungsteam sowie Produkt und Business zusammen.

Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kommst nicht in eine fertige entwickelte Organisation mit jahrelang etablierten und zementierten Strukturen. Du kannst unsere Architektur, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere technische Entwicklung unmittelbar mitprägen.

Zentrale Lage & Arbeitsmodell: Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell. Unser zentral gelegenes Büro ist gut erreichbar und bietet Raum für Austausch und Zusammenarbeit, mobiles Arbeiten ist möglich.

Gesundheit & Mobilität: Mit dem Jobticket bist Du entspannt in der Stadt unterwegs und der EGYM Wellpass bietet Dir Ausgleich in über 6.000 Sport- und Wellness-Einrichtungen.

Feiertags-Bonus: Heiligabend und Silvester sind bei uns arbeitsfrei. Du sparst Dir deinen Urlaub und startest entspannt und ohne Abzüge ins neue Jahr.

Interessiert?

Dann bewirb Dich einfach direkt hier über die Website.

Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

new_jobs.description:
Wer wir sind

Die MAXXYS AG ist Teil der GBC Group, eines der am schnellsten wachsenden IT-Service-Unternehmen in Deutschland. Wir bedienen über 3.500 aktive Kunden und verfügen über rund 500 Mitarbeiter an 13 Standorten. Als inhabergeführte Unternehmensgruppe legen wir Wert auf Struktur, messbare Ergebnisse und klare Zielvorgaben statt auf Micromanagement. Unsere Kultur fördert Eigenverantwortung und Entwicklung durch Leistung, nicht durch Titel. Wir suchen keine „passt schon“-Mentalitäten, sondern Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und Leistung transparent akzeptieren.

Dein Wirkungsfeld

In dieser Rolle bist du der technische Brückenbauer zwischen komplexen Kundenanforderungen und unseren Enterprise-Lösungen. Du bist verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und Validierung von Lösungsarchitekturen in den Bereichen Automation, Observability und Network Monitoring. Deine Arbeit entscheidet mit, ob unsere Kunden ihre IT-Infrastruktur sicher, effizient und zukunftsorientiert betreiben können. Du trägst direkte Verantwortung für den Erfolg von Proof of Concepts, technischen Workshops und der Integration neuer Technologien in bestehende Landschaften. Dein Beitrag ermöglicht es MAXXYS, sich als kompetenter Partner für hochkomplexe IT-Umgebungen zu positionieren und Kundenerfolge messbar zu liefern.

Deine Aufgaben & Verantwortung

Analyse komplexer Kundenumgebungen und Ableitung konkreter technischer Anforderungen
Entwicklung von Lösungsarchitekturen in den Bereichen Automation, Observability und Network Monitoring sowie Entscheidungsfindung bei Technologiefragen
Durchführung technischer Workshops, Präsentationen und Demos; Übernahme der Verantwortung für erfolgreiche Proof of Concepts
Installation, Konfiguration und Integration von Enterprise-Softwarelösungen in Kundensystemen
Lösung komplexer technischer Problemstellungen durch eigenständige Ursachenanalyse und Troubleshooting
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Herstellern, Kunden und internen Consultants zur Sicherstellung nahtloser Prozesse
Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Demo-, Test- und Lab-Umgebungen zur Validierung neuer Technologien
Kontinuierliche Einarbeitung in neue Technologien und Produkte sowie Transfer des Wissens in die Praxis

Was Du mitbringst

Muss-Kriterien

Fundierte technische Kenntnisse im IT-Umfeld mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell zu verstehen
Erfahrung mit größeren oder komplexen Enterprise-IT-Umgebungen
Freude an Troubleshooting und technischer Ursachenanalyse
Eigenständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
Klare Kommunikation im Umgang mit technischen Ansprechpartnern und Kunden
Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
Technisches Grundwissen idealerweise in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: Linux/Windows Server, Netzwerke (TCP/IP, Routing, DNS, Firewalls, Proxies), APIs/Systemintegration (REST), Scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python), Virtualisierung/Container, Datenbanken, Monitoring/Observability/IT-Automation

Kann-Kriterien

Erfahrung mit Broadcom Automic Automation, AppNeta oder DX NetOps
Kenntnisse in anderen Enterprise-Automation- oder Workload-Automation-Lösungen
Erfahrung mit Netzwerk-Monitoring oder Application Performance Monitoring
Kenntnisse in Kubernetes, Cloud-Technologien, VMware/VMware Cloud Foundation
Erfahrung mit Kafka oder anderen Event-Streaming-Technologien
Erfahrung mit hybriden IT-Landschaften
Hinweis: Wir legen keinen Wert auf reine Produktzertifizierungen, sondern auf deine Fähigkeit, dich selbstständig in unbekannte Themen einzuarbeiten und Probleme durch tiefes Verständnis zu lösen

Was Dich bei uns erwartet

Du arbeitest in einem leistungsorientierten Umfeld mit klaren Zielen und messbaren Ergebnissen. Wir bieten dir einen hohen Remote-Anteil, mit der Möglichkeit der Zusammenarbeit aus der Nähe von Butzbach. Du erhältst Verantwortung statt Kontrolle und wirst durch deine Leistung gefördert, nicht durch formelle Titel. Unsere Kultur zeichnet sich durch direkte Kommunikation, professionelle Zusammenarbeit und den Verzicht auf Floskeln aus. new_jobs.title: Senior Java Developer (Microservices)
new_jobs.description:
Project Description:

You will join a long-term, enterprise-scale project for a global client in the investment banking domain. The project focuses on building and evolving a set of mission-critical backend services that support complex business workflows, regulatory processes, and system integrations across the bank’s ecosystem.

The platform is based on a distributed microservices architecture, leveraging Spring Boot, event-driven communication, and BPM-driven process orchestration. The system operates in a cloud-enabled, containerized environment, with a strong emphasis on security, scalability, resiliency, and maintainability.

You will work closely with architects, QA engineers, DevOps, and business stakeholders in an agile setup, contributing not only code but also technical direction, best practices, and mentoring.

Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot
• Contribute to the design and evolution of distributed microservices architectures
• Implement and integrate REST and SOAP APIs and event-driven solutions using Kafka
• Develop and maintain business process workflows using a BPM engine (preferably Flowable)
• Ensure high standards of code quality by applying SOLID principles, Clean Code, and design patterns
• Write and maintain comprehensive unit and integration tests using JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, and WireMock
• Work with relational and document databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Azure Cosmos DB
• Implement security and authentication mechanisms using OAuth2, JWT, and Spring Security
• Collaborate with DevOps teams on containerization and deployment using Docker and Kubernetes
• Participate actively in agile ceremonies (refinement, planning, reviews, retrospectives)
• Provide technical guidance, perform code reviews, and advocate for engineering best practices
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including QA, DevOps, and product owners

- Solid experience in JVM programming languages (ideally Java11+) and design patterns
- Frameworks: Spring Boot

- Understanding of distributed microservices architectures and communication patterns
- Experience with relational and document databases (PostgresSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos)
- Testing Frameworks (JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, WireMock)
- Messaging & Integration (Kafka, REST, SOAP)
- Security & Authentication (OAuth2, JWT, Spring Security)
- Containerization & Orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)

- Experience with Agile mode of working
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills
- Familiarity with Cloud based technologies

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer / AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
We're growing our engineering team and looking for both Software Engineers and AI Engineers to help build the next generation of Aleido's platform. Whether your strength is solid, scalable software or applying AI to real products, you'll join a team where AI isn't a side project. It's built into what we deliver and how we build it.

About The Role

You'll work on Aleido's modular platform for product information, used by some of the world's leading industrial companies to create, manage and deliver technical content. You'll own work from specification to deployment, contribute to technical decisions and help shape how we engineer as a team.

You'll Join Us In One Of Two Directions

As a Software Engineer, you'll focus on building high-quality features across the platform: APIs, cloud services and modular architecture on Azure and .NET.
As an AI Engineer, you'll focus on bringing AI into the platform and our products: LLM-powered features, agent integrations, automation and tooling that turns AI capabilities into measurable customer value.

Both directions share the same foundation and work closely together.

What You'll Do

Own development tasks from specification to deployment.
Write high-quality, scalable and maintainable code, using AI-assisted development to work faster without compromising quality.
Contribute to design and architecture discussions and propose technical solutions.
Perform thorough code reviews and contrubute to overall code validation and quality practices.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners and UX to refine requirements.
Support platform operations, monitoring and troubleshooting.
Improve workflows, documentation and engineering standards, including how we work with AI.
Stay curious about new technologies and help keep our solutions ahead of the curve.

Who You Are

We believe that you have:

A strong understanding of software engineering, cloud services and distributed systems.
Good experience with Azure, .NET or an equivalent modern tech stack.
An understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and observability.
A clear grasp of API design, modular architecture and platform patterns.
Hands-on experience using AI tools in your development work, and genuine interest in where this technology is heading.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, and a sense of ownership for what you deliver.
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Fluency in English, written and spoken.

For the AI Engineer direction, we also expect experience building with LLMs, AI services or frameworks (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI or Azure AI services), and with integrating AI capabilities into .NET applications.

Nice to have

Experience with Azure cloud platform.
Familiarity of AI/ML-enabled systems, including information flow, uncertainty and error propagation, common failure modes, and approaches to troubleshooting and debugging.
Experience with agentic workflows, MCP or other AI integration patterns.
Understanding of business process mapping and optimization techniques.
Familiarity with content management, technical documentation or aftermarket information.

Who We Are

Aleido is a Swedish international company with a long heritage of driving the development of product information and learning solutions. Our customers develop complex products or systems, or seek knowledge and confidence to create lasting change, within a wide range of industries including automotive, telecom, advanced machinery, rail and medtech. We are almost a thousand colleagues in five countries. Together we bridge the gap between technology and the people who depend on it – by making the advanced simply understood.

You'll be part of a tight-knit and innovative team where your work truly makes a difference. We believe in empowering people, embracing creativity and constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with software and AI.

Otto HR is a unified platform for hiring, people operations, payroll, benefits, and compliance, powered by Otto, an AI assistant that works alongside HR teams. The company was founded to solve the challenges of managing a growing organization, replacing fragmented tools and manual workflows with a single, integrated system.
